gate.approval.wholeModel: The whole model {{model}} (approved on main: changing it needs the whole model approved again)
gate.approval.approvedModelsFailed: Could not read which models are approved on main, so it is unknown whether the whole model must be approved again; approval is unavailable: {{message}}
gate.approval.releaseApproves: Will approve: the whole model {{model}}, approver {{approver}} (a release does not pick elements).
gate.approval.releaseStale: This release approval branch is based on {{commit}}, but origin/main is now {{main}}: it can be neither approved nor rejected. Prepare a new release branch.
gate.approval.releaseMainUnknown: The latest commit of origin/main could not be read, so the release cannot be approved or rejected yet.
gate.approval.releaseHeadNotR: The head {{head}} of this release approval branch is not origin/main's latest commit {{main}}: it may already have a decision, or the branch was not cut from the latest commit. It can be neither approved nor rejected; wait for a decided branch to be pushed and merged, otherwise prepare a new release branch.
gate.approval.releaseApproversFailed: The approvers could not be read, so the release cannot be approved or rejected yet: {{message}}
gate.approval.none: No added or modified elements to approve.
gate.approval.noApprovers: No stakeholder in the model can approve.
gate.approval.writing: Writing: the server runs the full gate check first, which can take tens of seconds. You cannot submit again meanwhile.
gate.approval.alreadyApproved: The branch tip is already an approval commit ({{stage}}). Writing another record (an approval or a rejection) puts it on top, which the merge exemption does not allow and which needs a fresh review.
gate.approval.progressUnknown: Could not read the approval progress, so it is unknown whether the branch tip is already approved.
gate.approval.coverageUnknown: Could not read what this head already approved, so it is unknown whether this gate and these elements were approved before.
gate.approval.confirmRepeat: I confirm writing another record on this branch
gate.approval.alreadyCovered: This branch already approved this selection ({{records}}), so Approve is off: approving it again would only add a second record. You can still reject, pick another gate or check other elements.
gate.approval.gateFailed: The gate check failed, so this commit can only be rejected.
gate.approval.duplicate: The same record already exists ({{record}}, commit {{commit}}); nothing new was written.
gate.approval.staleHead: The branch has new commits. Reload this page to see the new diff before approving.
section.aiActivity.gateNeedsServer: The gate page needs the model server (VITE_AISEP_MCP_URL).
section.gates.branchMarksUnknown: Could not read the approvals on {{branches}}: elements already approved there may not be marked.
gate.approval.notApprovableFailed: Could not check which elements can be approved, so nothing is prefilled: {{message}}
gate.progress.title: Approval progress
gate.progress.fetchNote: Read from Git on the model server's repository, checked every 15 seconds. The server never fetches: “Pushed” and “Merged” follow origin as of the last git fetch there.
callLog.title: Call log
callLog.notice.body: This page reads the local server's call log. It records only write and action calls made through MCP (successful and refused); read-only calls are not recorded, and changes made outside MCP leave no record. An agent can bypass, edit or delete this log, so it is not audit or identity evidence.
callLog.unconnected: The server has no model_call_log yet (depends on aisep #170 and the interface proposal). The entries below are illustrative, not real calls.
callLog.empty.noPath: The server found no log location (see its stderr).
callLog.empty.noLog: There is no call log on this machine yet.
callLog.detail.declared: Declared by the caller: for correlation only, never for decisions
callLog.detail.noTarget: Refused before a repository was resolved
